title_sq: Apartamente 1+1 dhe 2+1 te liqeni i Farkes
description_sq:
Smart Hills eshte nje nder projektet me te reja ne zone i cili pozicionohet ne perendim te liqenit te Farkes.
Kjo zone eshte e njohur per vlerat e saj rezidenciale te cilat shprehen ne aspektin klimaterik dhe ambiental.
Vlen te permendet pamja panoramike qe ofrohet ne drejtim te Jug-Perendimit.
Zona eshte e pasur me burime ujore ne formen e liqeneve , baseneve ujore dhe perrenjve.Bimesia ne kete zone eshte e pasur me lloje te tipit shkurre dhe pemetari mesatare.Vlen te permendim Liqenin e Farkes i cili eshte nje atraksion qe ndodhet rreth 200 m nga vendodhja e prones.
Ne aspektin e sherbimeve tregtare, prona ka nje distance prej 3.7 km, nga Qendra tregtare TEG.
Lidhja kryesore me qendren e qytetit te Tiranes, realizohet nepermjet Unazes Lindore dhe rruges Panorama e Liqenit.
Rrjeti rrugor eshte i brendshem duke lehtesuar aksesin ne cdo banese . Per krijimin e nje parku rekreativ eshte menduar pjesa qe ndodhet ne qender te zones duke bere te mundur qasjen e barabarte persa i perket
distancave nga te gjithe banoret.
Palacinat jane pozicionuar ne kufirin Juglindor te zones. Duke shfrytezuar terrenin e pjerret dhe germimin.
Parkimi eshte menduar te jete nentokesor. Hyrja per ne parkim nuk do te kete nevoje per rampe me shume pjerresi
sepse eshte pozicionuar ne pjesen me te ulet te terrenit per cdo objekt. Nr i parkimeve ne keto palacina mund te
shtohet pasi vendosja me distance te konsiderueshme nga njera tjetra mundeson zgjerimin e parkimit. Hyrja per
kembesoret eshte menduar te jete po ne katin nentoke, ne pjesen me te ulet. Siperfqaja e ketij kati mund te varioje
nga 390 m2 deri ne 580 m2.
Qarkullimi vertikal do te behet me ane te shkalleve, te cilat do te kene ndricim natyral, si dhe nepermjet ashensorit. Ne
katin perdhe te palacinave eshte parashikuar te jene tre apartamente, dy apartamente 2 + 1 si dhe 1 apartament 1+1.
Ndarja funksionale e tyre eshte qartesisht e ndare zona e dites nga zona e nates. Apartamentet 2 + 1 jane vendosur ne
dy anet e objektit duke krijuar keshtu mundesine e ndricimit dhe ajrimit natyral sa me te mire te tyre. Per apartamentet e
ndodhura ne katitn perdhe eshte parashikuar dhe aksesi ne pjesen e gjelber direkt nga ambjentet e brendshme te tyre.
Siperfqja e ketij eshte parashikuar te jete 370 m2.
Ne katin e pare te palacinave eshte parashikuar te jene tre apartamente, dy apartamente 2 + 1 si dhe 1 apartament 1+1.
Ndarja funksionale e tyre eshte qartesisht e ndare zona e dites nga zona e nates. Apartamentet 2 + 1 jane vendosur ne
dy anet e objektit duke krijuar keshtu mundesine e ndricimit dhe ajrimit natyral sa me te mire te tyre. Per apartamentin
1 + 1 eshte menduar te jete nje llozhe e bollshme. Per apartamentet 2 + 1 jane menduar ballkone te bollshme dhe qe
ndryshojne nga katet e tjera duke krijuar keshtu nje loje volumetrike ne fasade. Siperfqaja e ketij eshte parashikuar te
jete 365 m2.
Katet e para dhe te dyta kane veranda te medha te ndertuara ne harmoni me vilat.
Cmimi i afishuar vlen vetem per pagesen e plote. Per pagesen me keste ka cmim tjeter.
description_en: Smart Hills is one of the newest projects in the area, which is positioned in the west of the Farka lake. This area is known for its residential values, which are expressed in terms of climate and environment. It is worth mentioning the panoramic view offered in the South-West direction. The area is rich in water resources in the form of lakes, water basins and streams. The vegetation in this area is rich in types of bushes and medium trees. It is worth mentioning the Farka Lake, which is an attraction located about 200 m from the location of the property. In terms of commercial services, the property has a distance of 3.7 km from the TEG shopping center. The main connection with the center of the city of Tirana is realized through the Eastern ring road and Panorama e Liqeni street. The road network is internal, facilitating access to every apartment. For the creation of a recreational park, the part located in the center of the area is considered, making possible equal access in terms of distances from all residents. The palaces are positioned on the South-East border of the area. Taking advantage of the sloping terrain and excavation. The parking is supposed to be underground. The entrance to the parking lot will not need a steeper ramp because it is positioned in the lowest part of the terrain for each object. The number of parking spaces in these palaces can be increased since the placement at a considerable distance from one another allows for the expansion of parking. The entrance for pedestrians is supposed to be on the ground floor, in the lowest part. The area of ​​this floor can vary from 390 m2 to 580 m2. Vertical circulation will be done through the stairs, which will have natural lighting, as well as through the elevator. On the ground floor of the palaces, it is planned to have three apartments, two 2 + 1 apartments and 1 1 + 1 apartment. Their functional division is clearly separated day area from night area. The 2 + 1 apartments are located on two sides of the building, thus creating the possibility of the best natural lighting and ventilation. For the apartments located on the ground floor, access to the green area is provided directly from their interiors. Its surface is estimated to be 370 m2. On the first floor of the palaces, it is planned to have three apartments, two 2 + 1 apartments and 1 1 + 1 apartment. Their functional division is clearly separated day area from night area. The 2 + 1 apartments are located on two sides of the building, thus creating the possibility of the best natural lighting and ventilation. For the 1 + 1 apartment, it is supposed to be a spacious loggia. For the 2 + 1 apartments, spacious balconies are designed that differ from the other floors, thus creating a volumetric play on the facade. Its surface area is estimated to be 365 m2. The first and second floors have large verandas built in harmony with the villas. The displayed price is valid only for the full payment. There is another price for this payment.
